title: Worktree / Source Control View
purpose: Git repository browser showing commit history and working tree changes
states: no-repository - cluster active but not in git repo
no-worktree - cluster in repo but no worktree checked out
with-worktree - cluster has checked out worktree with changes
acceptance: shall display commit history graph for repository
shall show file changes for active cluster's worktree
shall display staged and unstaged sections when worktree exists
shall allow dragging divider between history and changes
shall show diff viewer for selected files
shall support review comments on diff lines
shall show empty state with explanation when no repository
